name: autoratchet
description: Deterministic complexity and lint checks for AI coding agents and the people who review their code. A ratchet on complexity and lint findings for TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python and Go, on your machine, in agent hooks and in CI.
author: Jag Reehal

scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.test: cargo test --release && pnpm conformance && pnpm fuzz
scripts.format: cargo fmt && oxfmt bin scripts conformance/run.ts conformance/bench.ts conformance/fuzz.ts
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --check && oxfmt --check bin scripts conformance/run.ts conformance/bench.ts conformance/fuzz.ts
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm test
